mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info ( order_no, user_id, restaurant_id, order_status, total_amount, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{restaurantId}, #{orderStatus}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, dish_id, dish_name, dish_price, quantity, subtotal_amount, create_time ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{dishPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotalAmount}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.order_no as orderNo, oi.user_id as userId, oi.restaurant_id as restaurantId, r.name as restaurantName, oi.order_status as orderStatus, oi.total_amount as totalAmount, oi.remark, oi.create_time as createTime, oi.update_time as updateTime FROM order_info oi LEFT JOIN restaurant r ON oi.restaurant_id = r.id WHERE oi.id = #{id}
SELECT id, dish_id as dishId, dish_name as dishName, dish_price as dishPrice, quantity, subtotal_amount as subtotalAmount, create_time as createTime FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_info SET order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_statistics ( stat_date, restaurant_id, order_count, total_amount, customer_count, create_time, update_time ) SELECT DATE(create_time) as stat_date, restaurant_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(total_amount) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as customer_count, NOW() as create_time, NOW() as update_time FROM order_info WHERE DATE(create_time) = #{statDate} GROUP BY restaurant_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, dish_name as dishName, price as dishPrice FROM dish WHERE id = #{id}
